GeBIZ Procurement Ledger

Every awarded public-sector tender in Singapore since FY2021 — filterable by API/integration category, vendor and ministry/agency. Built for an AE public sector (ASEAN) pitch for Postman. Note: this dataset is Singapore-only (data.gov.sg) — true ASEAN coverage would need each country's own procurement portal, which isn't included here.

Source: Government Procurement via GeBIZ, Ministry of Finance — local snapshot loaded from the CSV downloaded from data.gov.sg. Covers awarded tenders from Apr 2021 onward; live tenders and quotations under the small-value threshold are not included. Some rows show nominal S$1 or S$0 awards — these represent standing panel arrangements or tenders where no supplier was ultimately selected, not the true contract value. "IT relevance" is a keyword-based heuristic applied to each tender description (software, systems, digital, cloud, AI, telecom, etc.) — it is not an official classification, so spot-check anything you plan to cite by name. To refresh with newer data, re-download the CSV from data.gov.sg and ask for the dashboard to be rebuilt with it.

Why this exists: public-sector GTM lives and dies on whether you can see the buying pattern before the RFP drops — who's already spending, with whom, and when the contract comes back up for renewal. Postman's own product (APIs, MCP servers, AI agent tooling) is a near-exact fit for the pattern this data surfaces, so I built this as a working example of that argument rather than a slide about it: a live view of Singapore public-sector award history, filtered for the API/integration angle, with re-tender timing flagged so an AE knows where to knock first.

I built this during a break in the industry, as a working exploration of GTM thinking for the current API landscape — Singapore public-sector buying specifically. It started as a piece built for a Postman interview process; I've kept developing it since as a general demonstration of how I think about account mapping and timing in this market.
